title: Uniform norm on the sign cube
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in\mathbb R$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The product-space $p$-norm of $f$ under independent uniform signs equals its $p$-norm under the uniform distribution on the sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
